opportunities.best_time: Mountain Vista實際可到達且Denali／Alaska Range可見的白天或低角度光時段
opportunities.best_season: 全年皆有景觀價值；Mountain Vista道路車輛可達性受雪冰、季節與NPS即時道路狀態影響

condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"Mountain Vista Rest Area / Loop Trail public Camera Zone","subject":"Denali (Mount McKinley) + Alaska Range / Savage River Valley panorama"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: Mountain Vista當下可合法到達；不得由季節或好天氣推定Denali Park Road已開到Mile 13
condition_variants.required_conditions: Denali／Alaska Range主要山體或山稜層次可辨；能見度足夠；低雲未完全封住主體
condition_variants.boosters: 高透明度；晨昏側光；積雪／秋色僅作現況加分
condition_variants.penalties: 道路關閉；雲霧完全遮山；強降水；低能見度

viewpoints.note: NPS classifies Mountain Vista as a Scenic View/Photo Spot and directly documents clear-day Denali views. B72 moves the broad Denali Visitor Center weather anchor to the actual Mountain Vista scene and keeps road access fail-closed.
viewpoints.name: Mountain Vista Rest Area / Loop Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: Mountain Vista Rest Area、停車區與0.6-mile公共Loop Trail；實際道路可達性依NPS即時狀態。

opportunities.best_time: 秋、冬、早春的黑暗時段；NPS說明需同時有極光活動、足夠黑暗與清澈天空
opportunities.best_season: 約8月中至4月中較有足夠黑暗；實際能否看見必須依當時極光活動、雲量與道路狀態

condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"Mountain Vista public night Camera Zone when road access is open","subject":"aurora borealis + dark Denali foreground / northern sky"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: Mountain Vista當下可合法到達；天空足夠黑暗；必須有可靠的當時極光活動證據；不得只用月份或Kp單一值保證極光
condition_variants.required_conditions: 極光活動實際存在；主要觀測方向雲層未遮蔽；夜空足夠黑暗
condition_variants.boosters: 低光害；高透明度；雪景或山稜前景；較高極光活動
condition_variants.penalties: 道路關閉；雲層遮蔽；暮光過亮；極光活動不足

viewpoints.note: NPS explicitly describes Denali aurora viewing and notes Mountain Vista/Savage River night visits can be rewarding when access is open. ChaseLights does not yet treat NOAA planetary Kp alone as a sufficient local aurora-state provider.
viewpoints.name: Mountain Vista Night Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: Mountain Vista公共夜間觀景範圍；道路未開放時不得以步行距離或好天氣自動推定可達。
